entries.title: US P&C insurer claims analytics non-compete
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc may not develop, market, offer, or provide claims-triage, claims-fraud detection, or claims-severity analytics products or services to any US-licensed property and casualty insurer other than Halvorsen for 18 months from the Effective Date.
entries.quote: In recognition of the sensitivity of Halvorsen's claims and fraud data, for a period of eighteen (18) months from the Effective Date, AtliQ shall not develop, market, offer or provide any claims-triage, claims-fraud detection or claims-severity analytics product or service to any property and casualty insurer licensed in the United States, other than Halvorsen.

relatedClauses.quote: This Section 8 applies only to AtliQ.

entries.title: Mutual employee non-solicitation
entries.summary: Neither AtliQ Inc nor Halvorsen may solicit for employment any employee of the other party with whom contact was made in connection with the Purpose, for 12 months from the Effective Date.
entries.quote: For twelve (12) months from the Effective Date, neither party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other party with whom it had contact in connection with the Purpose.
